qEn: Which of the following is a Rabi crop grown in India?

qEn: In which state is the Kaziranga National Park located?

qEn: What type of force is friction?
qHi: घर्षण किस प्रकार का बल है?
explainEn: Friction acts between two surfaces that are in physical contact with each other, making it a contact force.

Battle of Plassey / प्लासी का युद्ध
Battle of Buxar / बक्सर का युद्ध
Battle of Haldighati / हल्दीघाटी का युद्ध
